verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Reader can be self-hosted from a prebuilt container image, and that schema/instruction extraction runs on Jina's ReaderLM-v2. Nothing documents a way to configure or swap in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend. Self-hosting the fetcher is an adjacent capability, not a pluggable LLM backend.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
